Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. • Seek Excellence.

Who You Are

You're a seasoned project controls professional with 7+ years managing schedule, cost, change, and documentation on large-scale, mission-critical construction programs — ideally in data centers, schedule-driven sector where downtime isn't an option. You read a P6 schedule critically — spotting broken logic, float that's been quietly manipulated, and a critical path that's about to move before it shows up in next week's update. You can pick apart a change order line by line and know a GMP well enough to catch a buyout gap before it becomes a claim.

You're equally comfortable pushing back on a general contractor in a weekly OAC meeting and briefing an executive on cost and schedule risk in five minutes flat. You don't wait to be asked for bad news — you surface it early, with the data to back it up. You build trust with GCs, design consultants, finance, and leadership not by being agreeable, but by being fair, prepared, and unwilling to accept a story that doesn't add up.

You think in systems — cost, schedule, risk, and change aren't separate disciplines to you, they're one integrated view of program health — and you're comfortable operating in an environment where the schedule compresses, the scope shifts, and the stakes don't.

What You'll Do

• Manage the third-party scheduling consultants who review, analyze, and maintain the master schedule, setting expectations for quality, cadence, and reporting
• Work directly with general contractors to review and validate their schedules — testing logic, durations, critical path, float, and sequencing against owner milestones
• Own schedule health reporting to leadership, giving a clear, honest picture of progress, risk, and forecast, and escalating issues before they become delays
• Own the change order process end-to-end: intake, review, verification, negotiation, and resolution
• Critically evaluate change orders for scope, pricing, and schedule impact — verifying quantities, labor, markups, and backup rather than taking submissions at face value
• Negotiate change orders directly with the general contractor to protect Galaxy's cost and schedule position
• Represent Galaxy in weekly change and progress meetings with the GC, driving accountability and timely closure of open items
• Maintain a complete, auditable change order log reconciled against the project budget and GMP
• Serve as the bridge between field/GC reality and Finance's cost picture, ensuring both tell the same story
• Own documentation control for active projects — RFIs, submittals, change documentation, meeting records, and contractual correspondence
• Establish and improve project controls standards, templates, reporting, and governance across the portfolio

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• 7+ years of project controls or construction management experience on large-scale, complex programs; mission-critical or data center experience required
• Proven experience managing schedule on the owner's side, including oversight of scheduling consultants and review of GC-maintained schedules
• Deep, hands-on command of CPM scheduling and Primavera P6 — enough to interrogate a schedule, not just read one
• Demonstrated experience owning the change order process, including verification and direct negotiation with general contractors
• Strong working knowledge of construction contracts and GMP structures (AIA A133/A201 or similar)
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents
• Excellent negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to hold GCs accountable and brief executives with equal credibility
• Ability to manage controls across multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

What You Bring

• An owner's mindset — you protect the schedule, the GMP, and the record as if the capital were your own, and you hold contractors and consultants to that same standard.
• The credibility to sit across from a general contractor and negotiate change with confidence, and the judgment to know which battles matter.
• A sharp, detail-driven eye that catches the number that doesn't hold up, the logic that doesn't sequence, and the risk before it becomes a delay.
• The versatility to move fluidly between the field, the GC, Finance, and the executive table, tailoring the message to each without losing the thread.
• A bias for order and structure — you bring discipline to controls, documentation, and reporting in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
• Willingness to travel up to 20% to Data Center sites as the work requires.

What We Offer:

• Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
• Flexible Time Off (i.e. unlimited paid vacation days)
• Company paid Holidays (14)
• Company paid sick leave
• Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees, partners, and other dependents

• Free virtual coaching and counseling sessions through Ginger
• Free daily snacks in-office
• Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
• Employee Resource Groups

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

About the Role & Program

Disney Consumer Products (DCP) brings the magic of Disney’s beloved stories, franchises, and characters to families and fans around the world. From toys to apparel, books to games, our global organization has a profound impact on The Walt Disney Company and the global markets in which we operate! With a portfolio of renowned franchises including Disney, Pixar, Marvel, 20th Century Studios, National Geographic, and Star Wars, we are a worldwide industry and category leader delivering innovative products that entertain and inspire!

In this role you will work with the Princess, Frozen, and Walt Disney Animation Studios (WDAS) toy design team to assist on specific licensed toy projects. Exciting daily tasks include identifying toy and fashion trends, brainstorming new concepts, developing inspiration boards, and sketching toy ideas. You will work with the design team to give guidance on product design to Disney licensees and work on 3 specific projects over the course of the internship, as well as being exposed to the daily responsibilities of the Disney Consumer Products Design team.

This is a rare opportunity to learn about the product development process from concept through production, working with internal staff and licensees. You will be responsible for working with the Design Manager and design teams to extend existing business and generate concepts for new business.

This internship is a full-time, in-person, six-month commitment in the Glendale, California area from January 11th, 2027 through June 4th 2027.

What You Will Do:

• Work with the product design Manager and design team on licensed Disney Consumer Products toy lines
• Participate in product approvals, including creative reviews, feedback sessions, and key meetings with licensees
• Make artistic contributions to new initiatives by sketching concepts, crafting trend boards, and sharing ideas
• Monitor competitors, product innovation, and market dynamics
• Research Initial seasonal trends by category
• Coordinate product submissions for creative reviews and approvals with the design team
• Coordinate and maintain product and market samples
• Recommend product ideas to build and strengthen businesses
• Present concepts and project deliverables to management and internal teams
• Participate in possible limited domestic travel for on-site product approval with licensees

Required Qualifications & Skills:

• Strong sketching abilities
• Solid knowledge of toy categories, particularly dolls, playsets, and roleplay
• Demonstrated creativity, resourcefulness, and innovative thinking
• Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills and confidence in presenting/public speaking
• Proficiency in creating and editing videos to be used in internal presentations
• Skilled at PowerPoint deck creation and delivery
• Strength in virtual platforms like Microsoft Teams and Zoom
• Genuine passion for drawing and the ability to create overlays
• Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe Photoshop, and Illustrator

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience creating POV/mood boards
• Passion for keeping current with trends in toys and design

Education:

• Junior or Senior year preferred, Pursuing a degree in Toy Design, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Fashion Design, Illustration, or a related design field

Applications without a portfolio link on the résumé will not be considered a completed application submission and may not be fully considered for the position. Please visit our support site for additional portfolio tips.

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all the requirements below

• Be enrolled in an accredited college/university, pursuing a bachelor's degree, taking at least one class at the time of application, OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship
• Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney Internship or Disney College Program.
• Be at least 18 years of age
• Possess unrestricted work authorization

Additional Information:

• The dates of this internship are January 11th, 2027 through June 4th, 2027

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across Europe. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across Europe, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions — including at the EU institutional level — as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

- Identify government partnership opportunities across Europe — from healthcare and education to defence, transport, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

- Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across European government institutions — spanning national ministries, agencies, EU institutions, and public sector bodies — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

- Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

- Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups — at both the national and EU level.

- Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

- Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across Europe, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

- Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — with particular attention to EU-level legislation (AI Act, GDPR, DSA/DMA) and its implementation across member states.

- Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

- Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

- Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

- You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

- You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

- You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

- You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

- 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

- A wide, current network of contacts spanning multiple European markets — across national ministries, agencies, and public sector bodies — as well as EU institutions (European Commission, European Parliament, Council). Depth in at least two major European markets is strongly preferred.

- Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

- Experience navigating the multi-stakeholder landscape of EU policymaking — member state governments, EU institutions, and Brussels-based coalitions — is a significant plus.

Also required

- Strong knowledge of the European AI policy landscape, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, DSA/DMA, and broader themes of AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, and competition.

- Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

- Public policy experience across Europe.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

- Fluency in English; additional European languages are a strong plus.

Location

This role is located in Europe.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
